id.description: Id of the MLS listing, the same as `id` in residential-listings. Each record in this file is the feature text of one listing.

highlights.description: The listing's highlights in display order: the short list of standout features Homes.com shows at the top of the listing page.

sections.description: The listing's details as display lines, grouped by category and subcategory in display order. This is the details section of the Homes.com listing page: every feature sentence, plus every feature with no sentence under its own name.

features.description: Every feature on the listing, one entry per feature, in display order. A feature with no value is simply present.

derivedValues.description: Totals and summary values worked out from the features.

text.description: The highlight as Homes.com shows it, such as `RV Access or Parking` or `0.49 Acre Lot`.

kind.description: What the highlight is about: `feature` (a feature of the home or community), `lot` (lot size), `hoa` (`No HOA`) or `nearby` (a short walk to a park).

category.description: The top-level group: `Inside This Home` or `Community Details`.

subcategory.description: The group within the category, such as `Kitchen`, `Parking`, `Schools` or `Listing and Financial Details`.

lines.description: The display lines of the group, such as `Gas Cooktop`, `3 Carport Spaces`, `4 Bedrooms | 2 Main Level Bedrooms` or `$4,047 Total Annual Tax in 2023`. A line appears once per group.

id.description: Id of the feature in CoStar's residential feature catalog. The same id means the same feature on every listing.

name.description: The feature's display name, such as `Dishwasher` or `Annual Tax Amount`.

category.description: The top-level group of the feature: `Inside This Home` or `Community Details`.

subcategory1.description: The group within the category, the same groups as `sections.subcategory`.

subcategory2.description: A finer group within `subcategory1`. Some names are internal labels, such as `Hidden Utilities`.

source.description: Where the feature came from: `Mls` (the listing's MLS data), `MachineLearning` (read from the listing's remarks or photos by a CoStar model), `Research` or `ComputerVision`.

inSentence.description: Whether a feature sentence shows the feature. A feature with no sentence appears in `sections` under its own name, unless Homes.com hides it, as it does utility connections.

boolValue.description: The feature's yes or no value, on yes/no features only.

doubleValue.description: The feature's number, such as a tax amount, a fee, a count or an area, on numeric features only.

stringValues.description: The feature's text values, such as a school name, a subdivision name or the items an HOA fee covers.

frequency.description: How often an amount is paid, on fee features only: `Monthly`, `Quarterly`, `Semiannually` or `Annually`.

totalMonthlyAssociationFees.description: Total HOA and association fees per month, in US dollars.

totalParkingSpaces.description: Total parking spaces of every kind.

totalBathrooms.description: Total bathrooms, with a half bathroom counted as 0.5.

lotSizeInAcres.description: Lot size in acres, rounded to two decimals.

propertyType.description: The home type, such as `House`, `Condominium` or `Townhouse`.

totalParkingGarageSpaces.description: Spaces in a shared parking garage.

totalPrivateGarageSpaces.description: Spaces in the home's own garage.

newConstruction.description: True when the home is new construction.

squareFeetMin.description: Smallest living area in square feet, the same as `homeSquareFeet` for a single home.

squareFeetMax.description: Largest living area in square feet, the same as `homeSquareFeet` for a single home.

availabilityDate.description: Date a rental becomes available, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

buildingStyle.description: The building's style, such as `midRise` or `highRise`.

totalMonthlyLandFees.description: Total land lease fees per month, in US dollars.
